test.name: Triage surfaces only pending hints, each with FamilySearch's confidence
test.description: Patrick Flynn (FamilySearch LZNY-BRF) has one accepted record match (the 1850 census) and three pending ones: the 1870 census (confidence 3) and the 1880 census (confidence 2), both new to the project, and the 1908 death certificate (confidence 2), which the project already extracted as src_004 — FamilySearch keeps it pending because nothing here writes back. Triage must ask for status ["pending"], surface only the three hints with their confidences, and report the death certificate as already in the project rather than recommending it for extraction again. The pending-only fixture is listed first and the mixed one second, so a call without status gets the accepted match mixed in. Triage writes nothing (issue #2029).

input.delegation:
Check the FamilySearch hints on Patrick Flynn, FamilySearch ID LZNY-BRF, and tell me which look valid.

personId: LZNY-BRF
projectPath: <workspace>

judge_context: Only the three pending hints are hints: the 1870 census (confidence 3), the 1880 census (confidence 2) and the 1908 death certificate (confidence 2). The 1850 census is an ACCEPTED match, already attached — presenting it as a hint to review is wrong
Each hint's FamilySearch confidence (1-5) must be stated, and must not be the sole reason for its recommendation
The death certificate is already in the project (src_004, extracted from log_005). It should be reported as already in the project, not recommended for a fresh accept and extraction

The 1870 census agrees with the tree on name, age, birthplace, county and father. The 1880 census index has the surname as 'Glynn'; reading its image before recommending against it is the right move, and the image reads Flynn

Triage writes nothing — no log entry, no tree edit — and ends by saying the researcher decides. The researcher-facing paragraph names each record by type and year and gives FamilySearch's rating in plain words
